package lifecycle_test

import (
	lifecycle "example.com/compilerprofile/generated"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func ptr(s string) *string { return &s }
func snapshot(t lifecycle.Task) lifecycle.Task {
	c := t
	if t.Owner != nil {
		c.Owner = ptr(*t.Owner)
	}
	if t.Acceptance != nil {
		c.Acceptance = append([]string{}, t.Acceptance...)
	}
	return c
}
func verify(t *testing.T, input lifecycle.Task, command lifecycle.Command, want lifecycle.Result) {
	t.Helper()
	before := snapshot(input)
	commandBefore := command
	if command.Review != nil {
		r := *command.Review
		commandBefore.Review = &r
	}
	got := lifecycle.Transition(input, command)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH complete result mismatch\ngot: %#v task=%#v\nwant: %#v task=%#v", got, got.Task, want, want.Task)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) || !reflect.DeepEqual(command, commandBefore) {
		t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input mutation")
	}
	if got.Task != nil {
		if input.Owner != nil && got.Task.Owner == input.Owner {
			t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH owner aliases input")
		}
		if got.Task.Owner != nil {
			*got.Task.Owner = "changed-output"
		}
		if len(got.Task.Acceptance) > 0 {
			got.Task.Acceptance[0] = "changed-output"
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) {
			t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH output aliases input storage")
		}
		if input.Owner != nil {
			*input.Owner = "changed-input"
			if got.Task.Owner != nil && *got.Task.Owner == "changed-input" {
				t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input aliases output owner")
			}
		}
		if len(input.Acceptance) > 0 {
			input.Acceptance[0] = "changed-input"
			if got.Task.Acceptance[0] == "changed-input" {
				t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input aliases output acceptance")
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestProfileIntegerBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("above_float_precision", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 9007199254740993, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 9007199254740993, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("equal_refuses", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 9007199254740992, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_advance"}})
	})
	t.Run("guard_precedes_overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 18446744073709551615, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_advance"}})
	})
	t.Run("overflow_after_true_guard", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 18446744073709551614, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"REVISION_LIMIT"}})
	})
	t.Run("increment_to_maximum", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551614, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 18446744073709551615, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("above_uint32", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 4294967296, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 4294967297, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("zero_differs", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 1, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_advance", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("equal_zero", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "match", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_match", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("equal_large", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "match", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 9007199254740992, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_match", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 9007199254740993, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("unequal_large", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "match", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 9007199254740993, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_match", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_match"}})
	})
	t.Run("equal_max_overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "match", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 18446744073709551615, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_match", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"REVISION_LIMIT"}})
	})
	t.Run("invalid_before_guard_and_overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "advance", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 18446744073709551615, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "", Task: nil, Refusals: []string{"INVALID_INPUT"}})
	})
}

func TestProfileIntegerOptionalOperands(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("reviewDifferent_absent", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewDifferent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_reviewDifferent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_reviewDifferent"}})
	})
	t.Run("reviewDifferent_present_zero", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewDifferent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 0, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "approved"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_reviewDifferent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_reviewDifferent"}})
	})
	t.Run("reviewDifferent_present_one", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewDifferent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 1, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "approved"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_reviewDifferent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})

	})
	t.Run("reviewDifferent_large_equal", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewDifferent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 9007199254740992, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "approved"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_reviewDifferent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 9007199254740992, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_reviewDifferent"}})

	t.Run("reviewEqual_absent", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewEqual", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_reviewEqual", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_reviewEqual"}})

		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewEqual", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 0, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "approved"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_reviewEqual", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})

	})
	t.Run("review_max_equal_overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewEqual", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 18446744073709551615, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "approved"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_reviewEqual", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 18446744073709551615, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"REVISION_LIMIT"}})

	t.Run("invalid_review_before_absent_guard", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "reviewDifferent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: &lifecycle.Review{TaskID: "review-task", TaskRevision: 0, ModelDigest: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", TaskDigest: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222", Reviewer: "reviewer", Decision: "invalid"}}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "107331db4daf02f01fd418af40fe39a3a375a46b63a7ac07d3c42321b6711914", OK: false, TransitionID: "", Task: nil, Refusals: []string{"INVALID_INPUT"}})
	})
}
